title: Every vector space is a projective module
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $V$ a $k$-module (a $k$-vector space). Then $V$ is a projective $k$-module [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]: $V$ has a basis, so it is a free $k$-module, and a free module is projective.
